sources.name: MedlinePlus / U.S. National Library of Medicine — Blood Glucose Test
sources.scope: General blood-test education: test description and result interpretation sections; not individual diagnosis.

scope: General blood-test education only, with the report's applicable laboratory interval. No pediatric, pregnancy-specific, disease-management or assay-specific targets.
overview: Measures glucose in a blood sample; meaning depends on the test and collection conditions.
high: Diabetes is one possibility; major illness, stress and medicines can also raise glucose.
low: Glucose-lowering medicines, insufficient food intake and some organ or hormone disorders can contribute.
caveats: These are possibilities, not diagnostic categories. No diabetes thresholds or treatment recommendations are supplied.

fasting_notes.unknown: Fasting status is unknown: use only general blood-glucose context, not fasting or tolerance-test diagnostic criteria.
fasting_notes.fasting: Reported fasting status does not establish duration or protocol. Do not apply diagnostic thresholds.
fasting_notes.nonfasting: Use nonfasting general context; do not apply fasting diagnostic criteria.
